name: Durak
description: Durak, the classic card game (the throw-in kind), against one, two or three computer players in a panel, to play while Claude works. 36 cards, a trump under the deck, attack and defend, throw in by rank, take or beat; whoever runs out once the deck is empty is safe and the last one holding cards is the durak. Easy and Normal opponents, your wins and losses kept, cards that scale with the panel, trumps marked by a corner tab and a four-colour deck as a setting. When a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you, the game pauses and names that tab, with a button to go to it. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session, runs nothing and uses no network.
author: BronOS
